body: Introducing IELTS (Writing on Paper)

Introducing IELTS (Writing on Paper) – a new way to take your IELTS test, designed for those who feel more confident writing by hand. 😍 With IELTS (Writing on Paper), you can: 📄 Take the Writing section on paper 💻 Complete the Listening, Reading & Speaking sections on a computer 📅 Choose from multiple test slots 🚀 Get most results typically within 2 days 🎤 Enjoy same-day Speaking tests 💰 Pay the same test fee It's the IELTS you trust—now with more flexibility to suit your test-taking style. 😊 Available in India from 1st September 2026. Advance booking open now. 😃 Book your preferred test format today.
